fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-10-18 at roughly 09:10, it was reported that the complainant paid an advance of Rs. 2,50,000 for a wedding hall booking, but the service was not provided and the payee stopped responding. Gopal Gopal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000034. A witness, Chandran Krishnan, reachable on 9000000031, was mentioned in the complaint. A further person, Kumaran Murugan, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000166, is stated to be associated with the incident. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100051. The complainant alleged that Venkat Prakash may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000439. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and a witness statement. The account SYN-ACC-100051 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00228, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payee reportedly stopped taking calls after receiving the advance.
